name: manual_93c1b7
claim: For any consequential action against mutable external authority (especially PR creation, merge decisions, or branch recovery), treat cached memory, a prior lookup, and a branch name as non-authoritative: immediately re-read current state, exact base/head SHAs, source-repository identity, and remaining delta; then re-read after the write. Missing, null, or truncated search output proves nothing, and creating a PR never authorizes merge, direct-main writes, deletion, deploy, or later side effects.

decisions.notes: 2026-09-12 stale-GitHub-state incident: a merged Agate PR was mistakenly described as open/duplicate from stale context. The corrective AFRP PR #356 was merged to Orama System main as 39988ce; a fresh Core sweep also showed the apparent pending Telos/GraphSpec branch already merged. The same read-classify-diff-reread sequence prevents duplicate PRs and authority overreach.
